title: Questions: who is reporting?
instructions: Mila asked Sofia lots of questions about life at Lakeview High. Later, **Sofia** tells her friend Aisha what Mila asked her. Write Sofia's words. Change the pronouns where necessary.
hint: Sofia is reporting: Mila's *you* means Sofia → **I / me / my**.

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Will you be at the football game?"
items.answer: Mila asked me [if|whether] I would be at the football game.

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Do you have a costume for Halloween?"
items.answer: Mila asked me [if|whether] I had a costume for Halloween.
items.hint: you → I, do you have → I had

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "What are you going to wear to the school dance?"
items.answer: Mila asked me what I was going to wear to the school dance.
items.hint: are you going to → I was going to

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "What happened at the school play last year?"
items.answer: Mila asked me what had happened at the school play [the year before|the previous year].
items.hint: *what* is the subject here, so the word order stays. happened → had happened, last year → the year before

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Can I come to your piano lesson?"
items.answer: Mila asked me [if|whether] she could come to my piano lesson.
items.hint: I → she (Mila), your → my (Sofia's lesson), can → could

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Why is your brother always so tired?"
items.answer: Mila asked me why my brother was always so tired.

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Where did you buy your boots?"
items.answer: Mila asked me where I had bought my boots.
items.hint: did you buy → I had bought, your → my

items.direct: Mila to Sofia: "Have you ever been to Germany?"
items.answer: Mila asked me [if|whether] I had ever been to Germany.
items.hint: have you been → I had been
